title: Integration identifies a normalized ordinary vector-bundle orientation
statement: Fix a finite purity setting $P$ with $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, for arbitrary finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $n\geq1$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $S$ be an affine finite-type $k$-scheme with structure map $a_S$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $F$ be locally free of constant rank $d\geq0$, and let $\pi:V\to S$ be its vector-bundle projection [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. In the ordinary small-etale derived category, put $\omega_\pi=R\pi^!\Lambda_S$ and $Q_V=\Lambda_V(d)[2d]$ in the specified base-coefficient presentation [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let $t$ be any normalized finite-twist transport, and let $c_t:\pi^*(\Lambda_S(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_V$ be its canonical Tate coefficient pullback [def-amb-vector-integration]. For every isomorphism $e:\omega_\pi\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_V$ satisfying the coordinate-counit normalization of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data], one has $e^{-1}=\operatorname{adj}_\pi(\int_\pi)\circ c_t^{-1}$, where $\int_\pi:R\pi_!\pi^*(\Lambda_S(d)[2d])\to\Lambda_S$ is the actual vector integration of [def-amb-vector-integration] and $\operatorname{adj}_\pi$ is the fixed exceptional adjunction. In particular this includes an empty base and rank zero.

proof.text: Reuse the proved Tate normal-form helper from ordinary orientation rigidity. It constructs the shifted finite Tate sheaf by induction on d using flatness, Tate products and derived tensor shift addition. The source is a sheaf shifted by 2d; the given isomorphism e makes its dualizing target concentrated in the same degree.

Use finite_type_frames to obtain a finite affine frame cover of S and its inverse-image cover of V. For each frame form v from the concrete trivializationMap, the affine-space base map, and inverse affineTraceAffineSpaceIso. Its projection equation is v;p_d=j;pi. The chart is etale and separated, finite type and quasi-compact; Noetherianity provides the compactifications. Empty bases and d=0 require no nonemptiness condition.

Choose a normalized projective-line family by exists_ordinaryFiniteP1Adjunction and identify its twist transport with the arbitrary t by transport uniqueness. Choose the constructed canonical compact-support normalization N. Evaluate the given orientation normalization and vectorIntegration_ordinary_frame_counit at each frame with these same data. Their right hand sides agree; cancel the invertible source-etale locality to identify the restrictions of e.inv and the actual integration adjunct.

Reuse the proved map_eq_of_cover helper from ordinary orientation rigidity. Homology in degree -2d is injective on maps from an object <=-2d to an object >=-2d. Naturality of the left-derived/exact pullback comparison and the exact functor homology isomorphism transports the frame equalities to equality of restricted sheaf maps. Jointly-surjective open pullbacks are jointly faithful on sheaves. The cohomology maps agree, hence the global arrows agree.

theorem vectorBundleIntegration_orientation_inv (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S] (aS : S ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aS] [QuasiCompact aS]
    (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates) :
    letI := isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType aS
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).2.1
    letI := isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F ≫ aS)
    letI : HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) := inferInstance
    ∀ e : P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) ≅
        P.diagonalTwistEtale (VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme S d F) d,
      P.DiagonalOrientationNormalization d (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) aS e →
      e.inv =
        (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)
          (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d).inv ≫
        (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
          (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)).homEquiv _ _
            (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration P.diagonalExponent
              (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
              P.diagonalExponent_annihilates S (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d F)
